name: Energy Performance Certificate bands A to G (England and Wales)
owner: UK government (EPC register); pages fetched are Barratt Homes and Fuse Energy
steps: A > B > C > D > E > F > G
notes: A 92-100, B 81-91, C 69-80, D 55-68, E 39-54, F 21-38, G 1-20 (SAP points); a separate environmental impact (CO2) rating exists but its bands are not listed on the pages; EPC valid 10 years; guidance scale only, never stored for a home

name: RICS Home Survey condition ratings 1 to 3 (with R and NI codes)
notes: 1 no repair currently needed; 2 needs repair or replacing but not serious or urgent; 3 serious and/or urgent; R documents to request; NI not inspected; guidance only, no value stored

name: RICS Home Survey levels 1 to 3
notes: ordered by depth of inspection, not by quality; Level 1 concise with no valuation, Level 2 in survey-only or survey-and-valuation versions, Level 3 most detailed with no market valuation

name: Agricultural Land Classification grades (MAFF 1988 revised guidelines, as used by Natural England)
steps: Grade 1 > Grade 2 > Grade 3a > Grade 3b > Grade 4 > Grade 5
notes: land quality: excellent, very good, good, moderate, poor, very poor; limitation: none or very minor, minor, moderate, moderate to severe, severe, very severe; classification scale only, never a value on a parcel
